name: zulf_ax_j_spectrum
note: Simple ZULF pulse-acquire on a 1H-13C AX pair using the shared z-axis convention.

theoretical_spectrum.summary: The simulated spectrum should show a dominant DC feature near 0 Hz and a second feature centered near 140 Hz.
expected_behavior: In the current project convention, ZULF() means prepolarized_z plus Mz detection.
That choice leaves a non-oscillating component at 0 Hz.
The heteronuclear singlet-triplet energy gap gives an additional line at |J| = 140 Hz.
With exponential apodization and finite acquisition time, each ideal line is broadened into a narrow peak cluster rather than a single FFT bin.
theoretical_spectrum.practical_readout: If the 140 Hz line is not obvious in the top few bins, increase T_s and/or reduce lb_Hz to sharpen it.
